_doc: Aerobatic biplane tuning (Farmlands theme), loaded over config/flight.json for courses whose vehicle is "biplane"; a key left out keeps the flight.json value. It flies like the stunt plane (same camera and handling, the stick banks up to TOUCH_BANK) with what aerobatics need added (js/aerobatic.js): the stick's up/down is the elevator (a pitch rate toward the plane's top, so on edge it turns, upside down it dives and a full pull loops), holding the stick at the end of its throw (past OD_THRESH, the last 10 %) rolls on past TOUCH_BANK at ROLL_ON rad/s, and letting go within ROLL_DETENT of knife edge or inverted holds it there (anywhere else levels out as usual; with the mouse, roll with A/D and it holds until the mouse moves). KNIFE_BAND: no bank-to-turn near knife edge, so it flies straight on a wingtip; ROLL_FADE: past this bank, none while rolling either, so rolling on doesn't swing the heading. INV_TOL: how far from upside down an inverted hoop still counts (rad); INV_SCALE: its size in hoops. WING_HALF is the model's half span, for pylon hits and the knife-edge slot's test.
